messages.subject: Starting point and repeated measures
messages.body_plain:
Hello Christopher,

I just knew about your toolbox and have two basic questions:

I need the toolbox only for network analysis (not network construction), but I would like to know the starting point of the matrix. Should I have binarized or weighted or Z-scaled matrices as a starting point? Should they be already thresholded?
I have a big group with three pharmacological interventions. Is it possible to use a GLM with repeated measures?
Thanks a lot and thanks for a toolbox in R!
Yacila

messages.subject: Re: [brainGraph-help] Starting point and repeated measures
messages.body_plain:
Hi Yacila,

It depends on the modality you have (is it volumetric, DTI, fMRI?). For DTI, you can start with the connectivity matrices; in the User Guide I show code for working with "fdt_network_matrix" from FSL's "probtrackx2". But it should work with any text files in matrix format. Pretty much the same for fMRI, but I haven't added  a function that will do the thresholding (the analog to "dti_create_mats"; I specifically wrote it to work with outputs from DPABI). So if you want to threshold everything yourself (in another program or in R) that shouldn't be a problem. If you run into problems, let me know.

I don't have any code for doing repeated measures, however there are tutorials online for doing these analyses in R. It would take a bit of code to manipulate the data properly so I could help when you reach that point. I have been working on a function for doing more general GLM analyses (to replace the "SPM" function), but I don't have a timetable for when it will be released.

Chris

messages.subject: Permutation analysis error [Graph Level]
messages.body_plain:
Hi Chris;

We did some analysis on our data before but recently maybe after some update it seems that we can not reproduce same pipeline again. We are having a problem on step 5.2.1 in your user guide. When we try the same code we get following error;

 permPlot <- plot_perm_diffs(g[[1]], g[[2]], perms.all, 'Lp', level='graph', + groups=groups, alternative='less', + ylabel='Average path length')

Error in `[.data.table`(perm.dt, , list(ci.low = unique(ci.low)), by = density) :
  Column 1 of j's result for the first group is NULL. We rely on the column types of the first result to decide the type expected for the remaining groups (and require consistency). NULL columns are acceptable for later groups (and those are replaced with NA of appropriate type and recycled) but not for the first. Please use a typed empty vector instead, such as integer() or numeric().

Do you have any idea?

Best wishes
Ozgun

messages.subject: Re: [brainGraph-help] Permutation analysis error [Graph Level]
messages.body_plain:
First thought: get rid of the "plus" signs that are in the code. However, if that is simply an artifact of the code that you copy-pasted into the email, it wouldn't cause the error.
It is more likely that the error is with "perms.all". If you send me the data I can take a look. Before that, be sure that "perms.all" has a column with name "Lp", and that all of your graphs in the "g" object have a graph-level attribute that is also called "Lp".

Chris
